items.title: Phasmophobia Halloween Event and Rewards Officially Revealed
items.content:
Phasmophobia Halloween Event and Rewards Officially Revealed From GameRant (Written by Joshua Duckworth) on October 7, 2026 | OpenCritic

Halloween has become an iconic part of the year for the best horror games , giving developers an excuse to bring players back for seasonal events, limited-time challenges, and new ways to make already-scary games even more unsettling. Few games are better suited to the holiday than Phasmophobia , which has spent years turning ghost hunting into a multiplayer experience where even familiar locations can become dangerously fun when the lights go out.

Phasmophobia has also made seasonal events a regular part of its yearly schedule, giving players another reason to return as October rolls around. The game's Halloween celebrations have become especially recognizable, often changing familiar locations and adding special objectives that give investigations a different feel. Phasmophobia is keeping that tradition going again in 2026, with Kinetic Games now laying out exactly what players can expect throughout October.

Following the launch of the buggy Player Character Update, Phasmophobia releases a patch and promises more improvements are coming to the game.

Phasmophobia's Crimson Eye 2026 event will officially begin on October 8 and run through November 1. Kinetic Games says the update containing the event will deploy on October 7, one day before the event itself begins. Crimson Eye...

items.title: Phasmophobia Update 1.000.049 Released on October 7 to Prep for Crimson Eye
items.summary: Phasmophobia update 1.000.049 is live on consoles and PC, and this brings the Crimson Eye data for the event start tomorrow.
items.content:
It’s another October, and this means another Halloween-themed event is headed to Phasmophobia players. While this year’s Crimson Eye event won’t start until tomorrow, October 8, Kinetic Games has pushed out Phasmophobia update 1.000.049 to pre the game for it.

The event will run from October 8 to November 1, which gives plently of time for multiplayer horror fans to partake in the ghoulish festivities.

For the event details and changes made, read on for the official patch notes straight from Kinetic Games

As with previous years’ events, the Crimson Eye will cast its presence across several locations in Phasmophobia. Playing on these locations will grant each player event points, working towards unlocking the Community and Personal rewards, details of which are below.

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We have an update for you.

Today’s small update is in preparation for Crimson Eye, launching 8th October 2026, with the focus on getting the game ready for the start of the event. Our next major update, our move to Unity 6 is scheduled for November and will feature a host of bug fixes and improvements, all of which we’ll detail in an upcoming Development Preview.

New

 

  • Crimson Eye - The Crimson Eye is upon us, Ghost Hunters. Once more, various locations across Phasmophobia will be bathed in the red glow of the Blood Moon, offering any willing Ghost Hunter rewards in return for completing investigations, optional objectives and more. For more information on this year’s iteration of the event, please read our latest blogpost. 

    [/*]

  • Seasonal Event toggle - As a new feature for Crimson Eye and future seasonal events, we have implemented a toggle that allows players to turn on/off the event maps for their session. 

    [/*]

 

Fixes

  • Fixed an issue that caused the white light upon being revived to flash rather than slowly fade in and out.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where an Easter Egg reward may not unlock, despite a 0x multiplier being active and the reward pop up being displayed.

    [/*]

Known Issues

  • The lampposts outside of 6 Tanglewood Drive may glow when viewed by the player.

    [/*]

  • The Fusebox location will not be hidden on the Truck map when playing on a custom difficulty.

items.title: NEW RULES EVERY GAME | | Live VOD @ShanaLeigh Santa Monica (D82idPVeLV)
The Steam Frame's First Halloween: 189 Certified Games, and None of Our Ten Scariest
items.summary: Valve rates Phasmophobia Unsupported on Steam Frame, on a build that no longer ships. Seven more of our ten scariest VR games have no rating at all. What is…
items.content:
I went looking for Phasmophobia first. October started this morning, my Steam Frame reservation is still sitting in Valve's queue with no purchase email attached to it, and the one useful thing I can do while I wait is plan what goes on the headset when it shows up. So I opened Valve's Great on Frame list, 189 certified games as of today , and searched for the one I would want on Halloween night with three friends and a bad idea.

Phasmophobia has a Steam Frame rating in its app record, and the rating is Unsupported. One test, dated July 22. One result line: UnsupportedGraphicsPerformance, the same token Valve hung on its own showcase, The Lab , a week later. On the Steam Deck the same game is rated Playable.

That sent me back to my ranking of the ten scariest VR games with the same lookup open in another tab. None of the ten is certified.

Two were never eligible. Resident Evil 7's VR mode only ever shipped on PlayStation VR, and Resident Evil 4 VR is a Quest game. Neither exists on Steam in a headset.

That leaves eight. Phasmophobia is the only one Valve has rated at all. The other seven are MADiSON VR , Alien: Rogue Incursion , Half-Life: Alyx , The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners , Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic , Into the Radius 2 and Metro Awakening , and none of them carries a Steam Frame compatibility record in its app data. No rating of any kind.

A blank is not a failing grade. It means Valve has not published a verdict, and plenty of unrated games will run. It also only describes what plays on the headset itself. Anything streamed from a gaming PC over the Frame's wireless adapter sits outside the program entirely, so if you own that PC, all eight of these behave the way they do on any other PC VR headset and you can close this tab.

The people this matters to are the ones buying a Frame as their only machine. For them the badge is the shopping list. And the shopping list has a hole where the horror aisle should be.

One exception is hiding in the box. Half-Life: Alyx runs on the Frame with no PC in the room , a copy comes with every headset, and it still is not on the certified list. Which means the Jeff chapter, number four on my ranking and the reason I once tiptoed across my own living room, is on every Frame Valve ships. The scariest hour a PC-less owner gets on day one lives in a game Valve has not rated.

Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is the real one. Its certification test is dated August 18, its app record points at Lepton, Valve's Android runtime, and it lists at $29.99, marked down to $19.49 when I looked this morning. In April I wrote that I would play it with the lights on. I did. They stayed on.

Then there is Ravenholm. Half-Life 2: VR Mod cleared certification in August , it costs nothing, and the town you were told in 2004 not to go to is in it. I have played that chapter in the mod. It works as horror for a reason nobody designing it twenty-two years ago could have planned: the gravity gun is the main weapon, so every kill begins with you pointing your own arm at a saw blade lying on the ground while something shuffles closer. Episode One is certified too. Episode Two is not on the list.

Getting it is the easy part. It installs from its Steam page like any other game. The catch is ownership: the mod is free, but it needs Half-Life 2 in your own Steam library, and a family-shared copy does not count. The team keeps setup notes on its own site .

Deadly Delivery is the multiplayer pick more or less by default. I have not played it, so this is the store page talking: up to six delivery goblins hauling parcels into haunted mines, online co-op, $9.99 at list, 90 percent positive. Horror is its second Steam tag, right behind VR, and Comedy is its third, so expect something closer to a scream-and-laugh than a scare. With Phasmophobia off the table it is the certified answer to what four of us play on the 31st.

Zombies are covered. Arizona Sunshine 2 and the Arizona Sunshine Remake are both certified, if shooting the undead in broad desert daylight counts as Halloween in your house.

The flatscreen half of the shelf, which is now 102 of the 189, arguably does better than the VR half. DREDGE is a fishing game that turns Lovecraftian once the sun goes down. INSIDE is Playdead being Playdead. Both are certified, and both play on a virtual screen inside the headset, which is not what anybody bought a VR headset for and is still a perfectly good way to spend a night in late October.

items.title: The Crimson Eye Approaches Once More
items.summary: Once more, Ghost Hunters, we pay homage to the Blood Moon. Our dear Crimson Eye. Today, we’re excited to reveal that this year’s Crimson Eye event will begin on October 8th, 2026, and run until November 1st, 2026. An update containing the e
items.content:
Once more, Ghost Hunters, we pay homage to the Blood Moon. Our dear Crimson Eye.

Today, we’re excited to reveal that this year’s Crimson Eye event will begin on October 8th, 2026, and run until November 1st, 2026. An update containing the event will be deployed on October 6th.

As with previous years’ events, the Crimson Eye will cast its presence across several locations in Phasmophobia. Playing on these locations will grant each player event points, working towards unlocking the Community and Personal rewards, details of which are below.

The following list of locations will be featured throughout the event:

  • 6 Tanglewood Drive

    [/*]

  • 42 Edgefield Road

    [/*]

  • Grafton Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • 13 Willow Street

    [/*]

  • Bleasdale Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • Point Hope (Standard only, Point Hope Restricted will not be included)

    [/*]

  • Camp Woodwind

    [/*]

  • Nell’s Diner

    [/*]

For those of you who have taken part in previous Crimson Eye events, you’ll know what to expect, but you’ll also get to see how Nell’s Diner and the reworked 6 Tanglewood Drive & 13 Willow Street look dressed in red. For newer Ghost Hunters, you’ll be tasked with hunting down Blood Moon totems and completing investigations and optional objectives to earn points, all while under the threat of Blood Moon weather, increasing the challenge you’ll face from ghosts.

Players will have several different unlockable rewards during the event: a seasonal event tee, the Beholder ID Card & Badge set and the Blood Moon charm.

Alongside these will be the upgradeable trophy. If you have previously unlocked this, you’ll continue to earn points and upgrades to your existing Trophy, rather than a new one.

During the event, we have a few different plans in place, so please do read on to learn what’s in store throughout October.

Twitch Drop

During the first week of Crimson Eye, a Twitch Drop campaign will be running for all Phasmophobia streamers. After watching a total of two hours of Phasmophobia streams, you’ll earn the Crimson Eye tee. The campaign will be live from the moment the event begins until 11:59 PM BST on October 15th, 2026.

Double XP & Rewards

As is becoming tradition with Phasmophobia’s seasonal events, we’ll be running a Double XP & Rewards event during Crimson Eye. This will be taking place between October 15th–22nd, with all rewards from completed investigations being doubled during this period. Mark your calendars, Ghost Hunters!

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association

Finally, during the final week of Crimson Eye (October 26th–November 1st), we’ll be bringing back Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with our friends over at the American Heart Association! Last year, the Phasmophobia community raised over $100,000, which was an incredible achievement and went a long way towards helping the AHA team with their important work.

This year, we’re planning to go bigger and better; this event, and its rewards, will be accessible to all Phasmophobia creators & players when it goes live. While we’ll share details nearer the time, we just wanted to get the dates in your calendars!

We look forward to celebrating our favourite season with you once again, Ghost Hunters.

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We’ve got an update for you.

Today, we have released an update for Phasmophobia to address several issues that were raised following our latest Quality of Life update. Thank you to everyone who has helped with information and feedback to help us identify and fix these bugs.

Our next update following this will be our transition to Unity 6. This will be releasing in November, which is just a little shift from our original aim of October. We’ll be talking in more detail about this update as well as our cosmetics update in an upcoming Development Preview. Rest assured, our Crimson Eye event is still scheduled for October. More on that at a later date too.

Full patch notes for today’s release can be found below:

New

    [/*]

  • Added more props and fingerprint interactions to Prison Entrance to assist with Ghost identification.

items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Today we have released Phasmophobia v0.19.0.0, our latest update that brings with it the second part of our Quality of Life update. Full patch notes can be found below, and in-depth details on what’s new can be found in this blog.

New

  • Added new Restricted variants of the below maps.

    [/*]

  • Prison

    • Brownstone High School

      [/*]

    • Point Hope

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Video Cameras, Photo Cameras and Sound Recorders will now indicate Duplicate evidence.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display faded text rather than the usual bold white text.

      [/*]

    • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

      [/*]

    • Tier 2 & 3 Sound Recorders will display faded sound waves.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The Journal will now display other player selections of Evidence and Ghost Type.

    [/*]

  • The Keys section in the Journal has been replaced with Items We’ve Found, this new section will show keys, the bone and seasonal event collectables.

    [/*]

  • Added the ability to select the Ghost Type in a Custom Difficulty which will set the multiplier to 0.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Legacy Badge section to the Customisation shop to allow you to edit your badge at any time.

    [/*]

  • Players without a Legacy Badge will not see this option.

    [/*]

  • Added a ‘Hold Use’ sticky note on the Training whiteboards.

    [/*]

  • Dead players and dead player bodies will now look dead.

    [/*]

  • Added unique video evidence text for shower and fuse box interactions.

    [/*]

  • Added an icon to show whether a ghost name is male or female.

    [/*]

  • The Evidence page will now highlight the required Ghost evidence when the player selects a Ghost type.

    [/*]

Changes

  • Photo and Video Camera screens will now disable when clipping through a wall

    [/*]

  • When speaking, the speaker icon on ID cards will now function for all players, including local player

    [/*]

  • Improvements have been made to the VR character rig, allowing for more accurate and responsive movement.

    [/*]

  • Players can now interact with a Spirit Box when not grabbed using Text Voice Recognition Mode

    [/*]

  • Custom Difficulties with a 0 multiplier will no longer contribute towards any progress, such as achievements and leaflets.

    [/*]

  • Pressing use while holding a lit T1 firelight will now use another, without having to wait for the animation to finish.

    [/*]

  • When a player dies, their voice chat will now be cut out as soon as they die in the animation, rather than at the end.

    [/*]

  • The Truck has been moved closer to the main entrance on Brownstone High School and Prison

    [/*]

General Fixes

  • Improvements made to network stability to reduce disconnects.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused the ‘’Ghosts Misidentified’’ stat counter to increase each time the Debriefing screen is opened, even if the Ghost was guessed correctly.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that prevented players from starting a game if the host left the lobby. The host’s ID Card would also still be visible.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused player photos to be missing from their ID Card after completing an investigation.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that gave players the ‘’Test Level’’ as a map for challenges.

    [/*]

Ghost Fixes

  • Fixed an issue that caused an Oni’s singing event to drain 10% instead of the intended 20%. 

    [/*]

Environment Fixes

  • Fixed an issue that caused Hiding Spots to be open despite the No Hiding Spots setting active.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused the sound of a door closing to play a long time after the closing animation had finished.

    [/*]

  • This issue led players to believe this was evidence of a Yurei.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused the wallpaper in Bleasdale Farmhouse to be replaced with the patterns from the Phasmophobia by Alan Wake event.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the hiding spot in the Female Day Room on Sunny Meadows.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on Point Hope that caused the frame holding the bell to disappear (PS5 only)

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused lights to remain red after a red light Ghost Event if the Fuse Box was off during the event.

    [/*]

  • Fixed a visual issue with the static TV VFX on 13 Willow Street.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue in 13 Willow Street that caused items to clip through the coffee table in the Basement Living Room.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused hiding spots to be ineffective on 13 Willow Street if the player uses the ‘I Wish For Safety’ wish from the Monkey Paw.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused Crucifix and D.O.T.S projectors to slide along 13 Willow Street’s rugs and gym mats.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused the incorrect footstep audio to play on the pathway and grass outside of 13 Willow Street.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused mirror reflections to not appear correctly.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that allowed players to climb on top of furniture in the Inspection Room in Prison.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that allowed Equipment to be placed above the bunk bed in the Orange Bedroom on 42 Edgefield Road.

    [/*]

Equipment Fixes

items.title: Phasmophobia Quality of Life Part 2 Preview
items.summary: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. Thank you to everyone for the warm reception to our first Quality of Life update last month, and we’re glad to see many of you enjoying Phasmophobia once more. Today as promised, we’re sharing details on the upc
items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Thank you to everyone for the warm reception to our first Quality of Life update last month, and we’re glad to see many of you enjoying Phasmophobia once more.

Today as promised, we’re sharing details on the upcoming second Quality of Life update for Phasmophobia. We’ll be releasing this update across all platforms on 25th August, 2026. Exact release times are still to be confirmed, so keep an eye on our channels for official confirmation of when the update is live. 

Let’s break down a couple of the features we’re excited about before sharing the full list: 

New Restricted Options

For a long while, we have seen folks requesting smaller versions of our larger maps in the vein of Sunny Meadows Restricted. With this update we’re excited to introduce Restricted versions for Prison, Brownstone High School and Point Hope.

As with Sunny Meadows, these map variants are designed for quicker games in locations that we know players enjoy but sometimes don’t want to be investigating the larger area. In the case of Point Hope Restricted, which will be classed as small, Ghost Hunters will be able to access up to the Dining Room while Prison and Brownstone High School will have multiple variants - classed as Small and Medium respectively - which will be randomly assigned upon loading into a contract. 

Brownstone High School in particular will have a total of 4 map variants following the update. With such a big map, we believed it was appropriate to give a variety of variations, giving Ghost Hunters a sense of mystery when loading up. Outside each Restricted version of the map, a small piece of environmental decor will signify which variant of the map you’re on.

Journal & Evidence Changes

We made a handful of changes and improvements to Evidence collection with the first Quality of Life update, and we’re doing the same with the second. As with all of our updates, we’ll be looking for and reading through player feedback on these changes so please do let us know your thoughts once you’ve spent some time with them. 

Since our Chronicle update last year, we’ve been working on finessing the Unique/Duplicate system. A change we’re introducing with this next update means there’ll now be visual indicators to show that a piece of Media a Ghost Hunter captures is a Duplicate without the need to check the Journal. 

To detect a Duplicate, keep an eye out for the following indicators:

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display a faded overlay, rather than the usual bold white text.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Sound Recorders will display faded sound waves.

    [/*]

Another important addition in this update is being able to see other Ghost Hunters’ Evidence and Ghost selections in the Journal. This means there’ll be no more need to double check with other players which pieces of Evidence you’ve captured and see other’s opinions on which Ghost the group is dealing with - and of course making sure everyone has the same selection when you’re leaving in the Truck!

Elsewhere, we’ve replaced the Keys section in the journal with the ‘Items We’ve Found’ section. Appearing in the order they are found, this will display collected items such as keys, the bone and seasonal event collectables. On this same page, a gender symbol (♀/♂) will now be displayed alongside the Ghost's name, allowing for easier understanding of male and female names and Ghost types - especially for non-English speaking players.

VR Improvements

With this Quality of Life update, we’re completely replacing the VR character rig across all platforms. This means more responsive movement in-line with your own body’s, improved accuracy on the character model to match player’s arm length as well as an overall improvement to visuals of the character model when playing with VR users.

We’re also addressing several regularly reported issues from VR players, which we’ll detail in the full patch notes at release. As with other areas of Phasmophobia, please do let us know any feedback you have from your time in VR or any issues you encounter via our Help Centre.

Gameplay Improvements

Finally, for today, we just wanted to dive in to some of the changes coming to the gameplay of Phasmophobia. Firstly, we’ll be implementing the ability to select the Ghost Type for any Custom Difficulty investigations. You’ll find this in the Ghost settings when setting up your game, as you can see in the screenshot below.

Another change with this update is a change to character appearance upon death. As seen below, the dead body will now be seen with a greyer skin as well as misty eyes. Dead players will also appear this way to others while Dead. In addition to this change a player’s voice chat will now be cut off as soon as they die - the moment their neck is snapped during the death animation.

Below, you’ll find a list of all the New features coming with this Quality of Life update as well as the Changes section. At the release of the update, as mentioned, we’ll share the full patch notes along with the list of Fixes for known bugs and issues. We look forward to sharing this update with you on August 25th, 2026.

New

  • Added new Restricted variants of the below maps.

    [/*]

  • Prison (Restricted version is classed as a Small map)

    • Brownstone High School (Restricted versions are classed as Medium maps)

      [/*]

    • Point Hope (Restricted version is classed as a Small map)

      [/*]
    [/*]

Changes

  • The Journal automatically opens on the Evidence page if the player opens it when Dead for the first time.

Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition Has Been Relaunched
items.summary: Phasmophobia: The Board Game has officially relaunched the Deluxe Edition for purchase, after being sold out at launch last October.
items.content:
Posted in: Board Games , Games , Tabletop | Tagged: Kinetic Games , Lost In Cult

Phasmophobia: The Board Game has officially relaunched the Deluxe Edition for purchase, after being sold out at launch last October.

Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have officially relaunched the Deluxe Edition of Phasmophobia: The Board Game since orders first launched back in October 2025. The board game originally went up for pre-order last year, and fans wanted to get their hands on the Deluxe Edition so much that it sold out faster than the main tabletop title. Now they have opened the shop back up for this version as they're making more units to purchase. We have more info on the game itself here, as its being sold for about $162. If you can't get it, that's okay; the normal version is selling now for the same price.

An eerie chill sweeps through your home. Grabbing your flashlight & Spirit Box, you descend the basement steps with trepidation. "Are you here?" you call out meekly. Your torch beam scans the room, lingering on the dusty Ouija board left on the floor in disrepair. Its planchette begins to move. "Y". Your eyes widen. "E". Your heart lurches. "S"…

Welcome, Ghost Hunters, to the paranormal world of Phasmophobia: The Board Game . Assemble your team of 1-4 players and explore iconic homes, or even build your own! An unknown ghost torments you within – commune with this spectral entity, discover evidence of its existence, and escape with your sanity intact, if you can…

Developed in official collaboration with Kinetic Games and created by Lost In Cult, Phasmophobia: The Board Game brings the chilling terror of the video game to life. Equip your team with iconic gear and cursed possessions as you investigate the haunted property; this chilling adaptation plunges you into a world of suspense and survival. The terror has crossed over to your tabletop — will you rise to the challenge, or unravel when darkness closes in?

With design from Lost In Cult and artwork from illustrator Jamie Flack , the game's meticulously-realized maps depict iconic properties from the video game with authenticity and careful attention to detail. Joined by carefully-crafted key items and tokens, all is entombed inside a reveal box guaranteed to turn heads and earn pride of place on your shelf.

items.title: Pre-Orders Return for the Deluxe Edition of ‘Phasmophobia: The Board Game’
Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition Returns for a Limited Time
items.summary: Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition ahead of its expected Q4 2026 release.
items.content:
Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the collector’s edition after the original run sold out shortly after it launched in October 2025.

Based on Kinetic Games’ hit cooperative horror game, Phasmophobia: The Board Game brings the ghost-hunting experience to the tabletop for one to four players. Investigators will search haunted locations, gather evidence, identify one of 24 different ghost types, and try to keep their sanity intact as increasingly unsettling paranormal events unfold.

The standard game includes investigator cards, themed dice, a Ghost Behaviour Board, more than 50 Hallucination cards, and everything needed to recreate the tense cooperative gameplay that made the video game a phenomenon.

Collectors looking for something extra may want to move quickly. The Deluxe Edition once again includes several exclusive items, including a digitally signed edition from the Kinetic Games team, a behind-the-scenes hardcover book, a secret film strip, Polaroid memorabilia, and a premium presentation box. It also features glow-in-the-dark components, metallic tarot cards, upgraded dice, and other cosmetic enhancements designed specifically for dedicated fans.

Lost In Cult says production on the board game continues, with the first shipments currently expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.

Given how quickly the Deluxe Edition disappeared during its initial release, interested players may not want to wait too long before securing a copy this time around.

Preorder a copy here https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/phas-std-sy5y5
